title: exact-llm: bit-exact LLM inference that is also fast
description: Bit-exact large-language-model inference: the model is defined as an integer program, so every conforming implementation returns the same output bits on any machine (verified on x86 CPUs and an NVIDIA T4, Qwen2.5 0.5B-7B). Group-128 int8 weights reach float-level quality (+0.14% / -0.07% perplexity). On a T4, batch-1 exact decoding was 1.04x (0.5B) and 1.06-1.26x (1.5B) the speed of an equally optimised float16 implementation; exact 7B decodes at 19.3 tok/s where float16 7B does not fit. Includes a one-request provider check, sampling receipts, a CPU spot-check verifier and portable LLM compression. Limits, prior and concurrent work, and failures are documented in the README.
notes: Built with AI assistance (Anthropic Claude) for code and analysis.
